props.name: children
props.comment: Extra nested routes appended after the CRUD routes.

props.name: hasList
props.comment:
Explicit route-flag overrides, OR-ed with component presence (e.g. a
resource whose list view is registered elsewhere but should still show a
"create" affordance).

props.name: icon
props.comment: The menu / breadcrumb icon (a React component).

props.name: list
props.comment: The list view (component or element). Presence sets `hasList`.

props.name: name
props.comment:
The resource name — the registry key and the route base (`<name>/*`). A
registered resource once `Register` is augmented, else any string.

props.name: options
props.comment: Open extension bag — the shadcn menu reads `options.group` (D9).

props.name: recordRepresentation
props.comment: How a record renders as a label (string field name, function, or node).
